name: Windfall Ecology Centre
serviceNote: Greater Toronto Area, with 20+ years delivering EnerGuide evaluations
registrationSource: NRCan list of service organizations for existing homes

pricing.note: Homes over 2,500 sq ft add $50–$150. Published openly — one of the only providers in Ontario that does.

profile: A non-profit ecology centre and one of the longest-standing licensed service organizations in the GTA. Windfall is also one of the very few providers anywhere in Ontario that publishes its evaluation prices — the kind of transparency this directory exists to reward.

name: Green Venture
profile: Hamilton's community environmental organization and the Green Communities Canada member for the Hamilton–Halton–Niagara territory, which previously delivered EnerGuide home evaluations alongside its local climate programs.
statusNote: Green Venture no longer offers EnerGuide home energy evaluations — its own site says so, and it no longer appears on NRCan's list of licensed service organizations (both checked 25 September 2026). It refers Hamilton-area homeowners to Reep Green Solutions and Windfall Ecology Centre.
